_meta.purpose: M-UI-A3 analysis-window-picker configuration. One profile per use-case (screening today, trend in future item 1.4). Component reads this fixture at module-load via demo.window_picker_profiles.load_profile.
_meta.coefficient_calibration_note: compute_estimate_coefficients are PLACEHOLDER values calibrated against the rule-of-thumb comments in pages/05_Screening_Results.py:188 ('~30-60 seconds') and pages/99_engine_scratch.py:192 ('60-180 seconds'), not against real benchmark logs. Recalibrate when timing instrumentation lands.

validation_messages.below_min: Window must be at least 30 days for stable measurements.
validation_messages.above_max: For trend analysis over longer periods, use the Trend page (coming soon).
validation_messages.end_in_future: End date cannot be in the future.
validation_messages.start_after_end: Start date must be before end date.
validation_messages.start_too_early: Data not available before {earliest_date}; the earliest valid start is {earliest_date}.

compute_estimate_coefficients.long_window_warning: Long windows may take several minutes. Consider running a shorter window first.
